title: Agents followed GeBauer's daughters to school
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Agents followed GeBauer's daughters to school, about 1940s-1950s at unspecified, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: His daughter even told the Ramsies that agents used to follow her and her sister to school.

plain: A podcast host named Jesse Michels tells of a man named Leo GeBauer, linked to a story about crashed craft and alien bodies from the 1940s and 1950s. Michels says that GeBauer's daughter told people named the Ramseys that government agents used to follow her and her sister to school. He tells it because, if true, it would suggest the authorities were watching GeBauer's family closely.
